//: Reference examples for configuring an AI provider in Recall (Settings → AI provider).
//key: API keys are NEVER stored in files or SQLite — you enter them in Settings and they go straight to your OS keychain. The 'api_key' fields below are only illustrative placeholders.

openai.api_key: sk-...              (enter in Settings; stored in the OS keychain)

anthropic.api_key: sk-ant-...          (enter in Settings; stored in the OS keychain)

gemini.api_key: AIza...             (enter in Settings; sent via x-goog-api-key header, never the URL)

openrouter.api_key: sk-or-...           (enter in Settings; stored in the OS keychain)

ollama_local.api_key: ollama              (any value; Ollama ignores it — content stays on your device)
